title: Add X-Forwarded-For Support to Rate Limiter
description:
Security review of PR #47 (email_09) identified that the rate limiter uses only the direct request IP. Behind a load balancer or NAT, multiple legitimate users share the same egress IP and would be incorrectly throttled together.

Fix: Check X-Forwarded-For header and use a composite key (forwarded IP + user ID for authenticated routes).

Also adding:
- Retry-After header in 429 responses (RFC 7231 compliance)
- Security audit trail logging for throttled requests

Fixed in the updated PR #47. Addresses Kenji's review from email_09.
